summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Network pages (Environments, Domain Manager, License Manager, Branding, Notifications) verifying upgrade from CSS gradient card headers to isometric 3D image-based headers. All 5 Network pages successfully render 260px cards with isometric images in h-[180px] header areas, radial-gradient masks for vignette effect, white glassmorphism badges (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-lg), and bottom accent bars. All edit/toggle/delete functionality remains operational.

issues: Minor: Console warnings about DialogContent missing DialogTitle for accessibility - not blocking functionality (same as previous iteration)

Environments_Tab.details: 5 environment cards rendered with 260px width, isometric 3D images (env_server.jpg, env_technical.jpg, env_radio.jpg, etc.), DEFAULT/ENV badges with white glassmorphism (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-lg), Cloud status badges, and colored bottom accent bars
Environments_Tab.images_with_radial_mask: Yes - radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 65% at center 55%, black 50%, transparent 100%)

License_Manager_Overview.site_type_images: SITE_TYPE_IMAGES mapping used for radio, technical, server, task_scheduler, external_host, wp_security

critical_code_review_comments: Minor accessibility warning: DialogContent components missing DialogTitle - consider adding VisuallyHidden DialogTitle for screen reader support (same as iteration_134)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 Network pages (Environments, Domain Manager, License Manager, Notifications, Branding) have been successfully upgraded from CSS gradient card headers to isometric 3D image-based headers. Images are stored at /app/frontend/public/images/env_*.jpg. Cards use h-[180px] image areas with radial-gradient masks for vignette effect. White glassmorphism badges (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-lg) are used throughout. All edit/toggle/delete functionality remains operational. The More dropdown in NetworkHeader provides access to Notifications and Branding pages.
